data.one_liner: An http.Client wrapper that automatically refreshes authentication tokens and retries requests.
data.what_it_does: Fresh_http intercepts outgoing HTTP calls, attaches the current auth token, and refreshes it when it expires or a 401 response is received. It also provides a stream to observe authentication state changes.
use_when: You need token‑based authentication with automatic refresh for http package calls
You want a drop‑in replacement for http.Client without rewriting request code
avoid_when: You already use a different HTTP client like dio with its own refresh support
Your app requires complex token handling that Fresh_http doesn't expose
strengths: Handles concurrent refreshes with single‑flight logic
Provides authenticationStatus stream for UI reactions
weaknesses: Limited to http.Client; not a full‑featured networking stack
Customization beyond provided hooks may require extra code

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Basic client without token management, lighter if you implement refresh yourself

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers its own Fresh‑dio package with similar auto‑refresh features for dio users
